statement: Removing an emulator from a CI runner does not prove a multi-platform build runs nothing emulated: BuildKit can carry its own emulators for foreign-platform RUN steps, so a build that succeeds without QEMU set up proves nothing about what executed. While fixing #421 (an emulated arm64 pnpm install that hung 2 of 20 release builds), the first planned proof was exactly that, and it was replaced before it was written. Rule: prove 'no emulated execution' from the build definition itself (the build stage pinned to $BUILDPLATFORM, no RUN in the final stage, enforced by a test with the old Dockerfile as its negative control) and confirm it from the build log (no RUN line labelled with the foreign platform), not from the absence of a setup step.
